svg.title: Three prompt rows versus three dependent single position forwards
svg.desc: A three-position prompt with one output selection processes three positions in one prefill with a three by three attention rectangle and 496 counted matrix operations. A one-position prompt followed by two decode forwards also processes three positions but selects three IDs, with rectangles one by one one by two and one by three, totaling 480 operations. These are distinct request workloads, not equivalent outputs or measured speed.
svg.text: Equal processed-position counts can have different phase work
P = 3, g = 1: one prefill, one selection
New rows: 3. Attention rectangle: 3 × 3. Vocabulary rows: 1.
Final valid KV length: 3. Required output IDs: 1.
P = 1, g = 3: one prefill + two decode forwards
Final valid KV length: 3. Required output IDs: 3.
Same processed positions and KV length; different requested work
Counts follow the fixed tiny model. They are not measured time or traffic.
